title: Design: Long and unusual names stay in their rows in the Bill Invoices To window
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, with a name that no other customer has and that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer C, so its card shows "Change".
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-13-after-change.png, bt-p1-14-after-change-open.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer D's page.
  2. Click "Change" beside "Bill Invoices To" on the left card.
  3. Click the "Bill Invoices To" field.
  4. Type the first word of customer A's name in the field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer C's name.

Step 2:

  • The "Bill Invoices To" window opens with its "Save" button.
  • The field shows customer C's name.
  • Customer C's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.
  • The name stays inside the field: no part of it runs past the field's right edge.

Step 3:

  • The list opens; its first row reads "[customer D's name] (this customer)".

Step 4:

  • Customer A's row and customer B's row are listed.
  • Customer A's name stays inside its own row: no part of it covers the row under it, and that row's text can be read.
  • Customer B's name stays inside its own row: no part of it covers the row under it, and that row's text can be read.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R4: “The window has a searchable "Bill Invoices To" field and a "Save" button.”
  • S1-R5: “The field's first option is "[customer] (this customer)"; picking it and saving clears the default.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Change" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build), "Change, open" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p1-13-after-change.png
  • bt-p1-14-after-change-open.png

The design's own words:

  • “Window "Bill Invoices To": "New work orders and part sales for Buda Truck Repair will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."”
  • “The list opens above the field when there is no room below: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)" first, then customers A to Z, the current pick "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair" highlighted. Closed without saving. Reshot after the tech review.”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
